paper_fact: traveling cost = collision-free robot path time (MoveIt/OMPL RRT-Connect + cubic spline), edges of undirected G(V, E)
model: e(v_i, v_j) = alpha * ||p_i - p_j|| + beta * arccos(v_i . v_j) (guide §8, simplification #1; theta = optical-axis angle, roll not modeled)

provenance.paper: undirected graph G(V,E); e_ij = collision-free path time between robot poses at viewpoints
provenance.reproduction: alpha = 1.2 s/m, beta = 0.4 s/rad, home pose = object center + (0.9, 0, 0.6) m looking at the center (guide §8; the paper gives no coefficients and only shows the home pose in Fig. 2)
provenance.engineering: arccos input clipped to [-1, 1]; unit-direction validation (atol 1e-6); Euclidean distance != real arm path length

units: seconds (positions in m, angles in rad)
indexing: E[i, j] = v_i -> v_j in input order; home_to_viewpoint[i] = home -> v_i; viewpoint_to_home[i] = v_i -> home
